dimensions.quantity: Slope derived from a gridded elevation model
dimensions.processing: Compute gradients in a lunar projected CRS with horizontal and vertical distances in meters; record pixel size and neighborhood.

dimensions.quantity: RMS elevation residual from a fitted local plane
dimensions.processing: Record neighborhood size in meters; compare Earth and Moon at the same spatial scale.
Select a documented thermal product; retain local time, season, channel/model, minimum, maximum and median. Earth comparisons require equivalent surface-temperature statistics.
Use a derived rock-abundance product and its label scaling and quality mask; this is not a direct count of rocks.
Use a derived CF product with appropriate quality and thermal corrections. This is a composition proxy, not a mineral identification or an Earth lithology class.

supporting_sources.purpose: Imagery for visual context and terrain interpretation
Neutron measurements for hydrogen-related context; not a direct ice map
Radar context; interpret scattering with roughness and geology, not as proof of ice

scoring: Only score extracted, quality-controlled measurements. Define activity-specific tolerances and weights with the Earth team; never score missing data as zero.
